gold_diagnosis: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma nasal type

1: Biopsy findings: sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells in the reticular dermis and subcutis, not consistent with cellulitis
Response to treatment: did not improve
2: Imaging findings: gastrocnemius myositis, extensive subcutaneous and superficial myofascial edema, and popliteal lymphadenopathy without evident lymphatic obstruction
Response to treatment: did not improve
3: Incidental finding: bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses six months earlier
Laboratory findings: mild lymphocytopenia, moderate anemia, elevated creatine kinase, elevated aldolase, and elevated lactate dehydrogenase
